title: Hearing on DYCD's Beacon and Cornerstone youth programs
summary: The Council's Children and Youth Committee held an oversight hearing examining DYCD's Beacon and Cornerstone community center programs, which serve youth and adults at 92 public school sites and 100 NYCHA developments. The hearing reviewed program funding, contracting concerns raised by providers, and outcomes for participants, noting Beacon centers served over 37,000 youth in the first four months of fiscal year 2026. The committee also heard several resolutions calling on the state and federal governments to fund youth-related initiatives, including sports program funding, fatherhood support, and baby bond savings accounts for children.
